scenes.heading: Five surprises
scenes.sub: Every Sunday has one. Here is the move for each.
scenes.say: Every Sunday brings a surprise. Here are the five you will meet most, and the move for each.

scenes.heading: 1. They sing it again

callouts.label: Press the verse number, or C

scenes.say: One. The leader repeats a verse or the chorus. Press that verse's number, or C for the chorus. Or click the card you want.

scenes.heading: 2. The order changes
scenes.say: Two. The order changes. Hold Shift and press Down until the right item is chosen, then press Enter. Only you see the choosing.

scenes.heading: 3. Scripture nobody planned
scenes.say: Three. The preacher asks for a reading nobody planned. Press the slash key, type the reference, and press Shift and Enter to show it now.

scenes.heading: 4. An updated deck
items: The planner adds the new file in Plan
Choose it with Shift+↓, start it with Enter
scenes.say: Four. The preacher sends a corrected slide deck. The planner adds the new file in Plan, from any computer, and it appears in your order. Choose it and press Enter. Never edit during the service.

scenes.heading: 5. Something goes wrong
scenes.say: Five. Something goes wrong. Press the full stop. The screen goes black, and you have time to think.

scenes.heading: The rehearsal
items: The trainer reads surprises from the notes
Run it twice: Reset training between
scenes.say: Now a rehearsal service. The trainer reads the surprises from the notes, and you keep the screen calm. Run it twice, and press Reset training in Plan between runs.

scenes.heading: Ready?
scenes.say: Ready? Press Space for the briefing.
